\begin{bankpassage}[id=SI04-P1-CHEM-S2-G7-8, source={Score-I - Test 04 (14 Jan 2022)}, questions={7-8}]
Calculation of percentage of carbon and hydrogen it is determined by Liebig's method. It is based on the fact that an organic compound on heating with dry copper oxide gives CO$_2$ and water. Water is absorbed in conc. H$_2$SO$_4$ while CO$_2$ is absorbed by KOH solution.

Organic compound $+\ \mathrm{O_2}\xrightarrow{\;\mathrm{CuO}\;}\mathrm{CO_2}+\mathrm{H_2O}$

Thus by knowing the amount of CO$_2$ and H$_2$O produced from a known weight of organic compound the \% of carbon and hydrogen can be calculated.

E.M.F. of a Galvanic all cell given by a thermodynamic equation known as Nernst equation.
\[E=E^\circ-\dfrac{RT}{nF}\,\ell n\,Q^{\circ}_{pc}\]
\end{bankpassage}

\begin{bankq}[id=SI31-P1-CHEM-S2-Q01, source={Score-I - Test 31 (29 Dec 2022)}, paper=1, qno=1, type=single, subtopic={Stoichiometry}, answer={2}, answer_src=key, difficulty=5, diff_parts={K1 S2 I2 C1 F0}, diff_note={concepts: number of correct conclusions from a balanced reaction with sulphuric acid | steps: identify mole ratio and mass ratio from equation; oxidation number change of carbon and sulphur; equivalents; check each of the listed conclusions | I: several conclusions need stoichiometry in different forms}]
Consider the reaction

$\mathrm{C_6H_{12}O_6+12H_2SO_4\to6CO_2+12SO_2+18H_2O}$

How many of the following conclusions are correct based on this equation? [Atomic mass : S = 32]

(A) Mass ratio of C$_6$H$_{12}$O$_6$ and H$_2$SO$_4$ present in reaction mixture is 1 : 12

(B) Mole ratio of C$_6$H$_{12}$O$_6$ and H$_2$SO$_4$ present in reaction mixture is 1 : 12

(C) Mass ratio of C$_6$H$_{12}$O$_6$ and H$_2$SO$_4$ reacted is 1 : 12

(D) Mole ratio of H$_2$SO$_4$ and CO$_2$ in reaction mixture is 2 : 1

(E) Mass ratio of H$_2$SO$_4$ and CO$_2$ in reaction mixture is 2 : 1

(F) Mole ratio of H$_2$O and C$_6$H$_{12}$O$_6$ present in reaction mixture is 18 : 1

(G) Mole ratio of SO$_2$ and CO$_2$ formed is 2 : 1

(H) Mole ratio of C$_6$H$_{12}$O$_6$ and H$_2$SO$_4$ reacted is 1 : 12

(I) C$_6$H$_{12}$O$_6$ will be always completely consumed in reaction.
\end{bankq}
